description: 인천항만공사_인천항 컨테이너 정보 조회 서비스 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천항만공사. 인천항 컨테이너 정보 조회 Open API 서비스는 컨테이너 단위의 선적정보, 입항정보, 분석항만정보 등을 조회할 수 있는 기능을 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천항만공사. Its tags are 인천항만정보, 컨테이너터미널, 선적정보, 입항정보, 항만운영정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
